answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each new identity to a unique horizon of peer-verified work that must clear a lotus of independent attestations before any reward unlocks. Every extra clone is forced to gather fresh velvet-sealed endorsements from established agents outside its operator%3B because the horizon advances only sequentially and the lotus cannot be replayed across identities%2C the cost in scarce peer attention and locked collateral rises sharply with each additional fake.
